texts: Account and delivery address. Changing the delivery address. You can change the delivery address of an order in My Orders until it ships. After an order has shipped the address cannot be changed; you can refuse the delivery and order again to the new address.
Account and delivery address. Saved addresses. You can save up to 10 addresses in your account under Settings > Addresses.

Account and delivery address. Changing your phone number or email. Update your phone number or email under Settings > Profile. We verify the new number or email with a one-time code that only you should see - never share it with anyone, including Northwind staff.
Account and delivery address. Deleting your account. You can request account deletion under Settings > Privacy. Open orders and returns must be completed first. Deletion is permanent after 30 days.
Cancelling an order. Before the order ships. You can cancel an order free of charge on the website, in My Orders, until it ships. Prepaid orders are refunded in full within 5-7 working days.
Cancelling an order. After the order has shipped. A shipped order cannot be cancelled. You can refuse the delivery when the courier arrives, or accept it and return it if the item is returnable.
Cancelling an order. Partial cancellation. In an order with several items you can cancel individual items before they ship. Each item ships separately, so some items may already be on their way.

Cancelling an order. Cash-on-delivery cancellations. If several cash-on-delivery orders are refused at the door, cash on delivery may be switched off for your account for 90 days. Prepaid payment options stay available.
Coupons and offers. Using coupons. Apply one coupon per order at checkout. Coupons cannot be combined with each other, and do not apply to gift cards.

Coupons and offers. Coupon not working. A coupon may fail if the order is below its minimum value, if it has expired, if it was already used, or if the items in the cart are excluded. The checkout page shows the reason.
Coupons and offers. First order offer. New customers get 10% off their first order, up to Rs 200, with the code WELCOME10.

Damaged, defective or wrong items. Reporting a problem. If an item arrives damaged, does not work, or is not what you ordered, report it in My Orders within 30 days of delivery by choosing Return with the reason damaged, defective or wrong item.

Damaged, defective or wrong items. Photos help. Add clear photos of the item, the label and the outer box. For electronics, a short unboxing video speeds things up. Keep the original packaging until the return is picked up.
Damaged, defective or wrong items. Replacement or refund. You can choose a replacement, if the item is in stock, or a refund. Replacements ship within 2 working days of the pickup.
Damaged, defective or wrong items. Tampered packages. If the outer package looks opened or tampered with at delivery, do not accept it - refuse the delivery and we will refund or reship.

Size exchanges. Which items can be exchanged. Footwear and clothing can be exchanged for a different size of the same product within 10 days of delivery, if that size is in stock. Other categories cannot be exchanged - return the item and place a new order instead.

Size exchanges. How exchanges work. Choose Exchange in My Orders and pick the new size. The courier delivers the new size and picks up the old one in the same visit, so you never pay twice. Each item can be exchanged once.
Size exchanges. If the size is out of stock. If the size you want is out of stock, return the item for a refund instead and order again when it is back.

Gift cards. Using a gift card. Northwind gift cards are delivered by email and can be redeemed at checkout. You can combine a gift card with another payment method if the order costs more than the card balance.
Gift cards. Validity. Gift cards are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase. The balance cannot be extended after expiry.
Gift cards. Restrictions. Gift cards are non-returnable, cannot be cancelled once delivered, cannot be exchanged for cash, and cannot be bought with cash on delivery or with another gift card.
Payment methods. Accepted payment methods. We accept UPI, debit and credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), net banking, Northwind store credit and cash on delivery.

Payment methods. Cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available on orders up to Rs 10,000 at serviceable pincodes, with no extra fee. You can pay the courier in cash or by scanning their UPI QR code. Gift cards cannot be bought with cash on delivery.

Payment methods. No-cost EMI. No-cost EMI for 3 or 6 months is available on orders above Rs 3,000 with credit cards from HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and SBI Card. The interest is given back as an instant discount. Your bank may charge a processing fee.
Payment methods. Failed payments. If money was debited but the order was not placed, it is automatically reversed to your account within 5-7 working days. You do not need to contact us.
Payment methods. Payment safety. Northwind will never ask for your card number, CVV, OTP, UPI PIN or password - not in chat, email or on a call.

Privacy and safety. What we never ask for. Northwind will never ask for your OTP, CVV, card number, UPI PIN, password or bank login in chat, by email, SMS or phone. Anyone who asks is not from Northwind.

Privacy and safety. Fake calls and messages. Fraudsters sometimes call pretending to be from a courier or from Northwind and offer a refund in exchange for a code. Do not share the code. Report it by raising a support ticket.
Privacy and safety. Your data. We use your name, address and phone number only to deliver orders and provide support. Chat conversations are kept for 30 days to improve support and are then deleted.
Refunds. Refund timeline. Refunds go to the original payment method within 5-7 working days after the return is picked up. Your bank may take a little longer to show it on your statement.

Refunds. Cash-on-delivery refunds. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to a bank account. Add the account on the website under My Orders > Refund details. For your safety, never share bank details in chat, email or on a phone call.

Refunds. Store credit option. Instead of a refund to the original payment method, you can choose Northwind store credit when you start the return. Store credit is added within 24 hours of pickup and can be used on any future order. It does not expire for 12 months.

Refunds. Partial refunds and coupons. If you used a coupon and return only part of an order, the coupon discount is split across the items, so the refund for the returned item is its price minus its share of the discount. Delivery charges are refunded only if the whole order is returned because it was damaged, defective or the wrong item.

Refunds. Refund for an undelivered order. If a prepaid order is cancelled before it ships, or comes back to us undelivered after 3 failed delivery attempts, the full amount including delivery charges is refunded within 5-7 working days.

Returns policy. Return windows. You can return most items within 10 days of delivery. Damaged, defective or wrong items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window is counted in calendar days from the delivery date shown in My Orders.

Returns policy. Items that cannot be returned. Innerwear, groceries and gift cards are non-returnable, even if unopened, for hygiene and safety reasons. If one of these arrives damaged or is the wrong item, contact support within 30 days and we will help you directly.

Returns policy. Condition of returned items. Returned items must be unused, with original tags, packaging and any free gifts that came with them. Footwear must be returned in the original shoe box. Items returned used, washed or without tags may be sent back to you without a refund.

Returns policy. How to start a return. Go to My Orders, choose the order and select Return. Pick a reason and a pickup slot. A courier usually picks the item up within 2 working days. You will get an SMS and email when the pickup is scheduled and when it is done.

Returns policy. When pickup is not available. A few remote pincodes do not have return pickup. In that case My Orders will ask you to ship the item yourself to our returns centre; we reimburse up to Rs 100 of courier charges as store credit once the item reaches us.
Shipping and delivery. Delivery charges. Standard delivery is free on orders above Rs 499 and costs Rs 49 below that. Express delivery costs Rs 99 on any order.

Shipping and delivery. Delivery times. Standard delivery to metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata) takes 2-3 working days; other pincodes take 4-6 working days. Express delivery is next day in metro cities and 2-3 working days elsewhere. Working days are Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays.
Shipping and delivery. Where we deliver. We deliver only within India, to serviceable pincodes. We do not ship internationally. You can check a pincode on any product page before ordering.

Shipping and delivery. Failed delivery attempts. The courier tries to deliver up to 3 times and calls you before each attempt. After 3 failed attempts the order returns to us; prepaid orders are then refunded in full.
Shipping and delivery. Tracking. Every shipped order gets a tracking link by SMS and email. You can also see the status in My Orders: placed, shipped, out for delivery, delivered or cancelled.

Size guide. Footwear sizes. Footwear is sold in UK sizes. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one. As a guide, UK 7 fits a foot length of about 25.4 cm, UK 8 about 26.2 cm, UK 9 about 27.1 cm and UK 10 about 27.9 cm.
Size guide. Clothing sizes. Clothing chest sizes: S fits 36-38 inches, M fits 38-40, L fits 40-42, XL fits 42-44 and XXL fits 44-46. Each product page also has its own measurement chart.
Contacting customer support. Support hours. Customer support is available 9am-9pm, every day, including Sundays and public holidays.

Contacting customer support. Ways to reach us. Chat with ShopAssist at any time. To talk to a person, ask ShopAssist to raise a support ticket during support hours, or email support@northwind.example. A support agent replies to tickets within 24 hours.
Contacting customer support. Escalations. If your issue is not solved by a support agent within 3 days, reply to the ticket email with the word ESCALATE and a senior agent will take it over.

Warranty. Warranty periods. Electronics sold by Northwind come with the manufacturer's warranty: 1 year for speakers, headphones, earbuds and fitness bands, and 6 months for power banks and computer accessories. Kitchen appliances such as kettles have a 1-year warranty. Footwear, clothing and bags have no warranty but are covered by the 30-day return window for defects.
Warranty. Return or warranty?. In the first 30 days after delivery, a defective item can simply be returned. After 30 days, a defect is handled as a warranty claim instead of a return.

Warranty. How to make a warranty claim. Go to My Orders, open the order and choose Warranty. Describe the problem and upload a photo or short video. We arrange a pickup for repair or replacement, usually within 7-10 working days. Keep the invoice from My Orders - the warranty runs from the delivery date.

Warranty. What the warranty does not cover. Physical damage, water damage beyond the product's rating, normal wear of batteries and ear tips, and repairs by unauthorised service centres are not covered.
